name: Best Friends Forever
source:
A visual novel about two different types of girls, each with different personalities of their own. But one day, they realise that they have a connection closer to them than they thought.

[From [url=https://strxberrybliss.itch.io/best-friends-forever]itch.io[/url]]

一部关于两种不同类型的女孩的视觉小说，每个女孩都有不同的个性。但有一天，他们意识到他们之间的联系比他们想象的更紧密。

[来自[url=https://strxberrybliss.itch.io/best-friends-forever]itch.io[/url]]
